==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:bor|la:prōiectus}}
From {{bor|en|la|prōiectus}}, perfect passive participle of {{m|la|prōiciō||throw forth, extend; expel}}.

Compare typologically {{m+|ru|прики́дывать}}, {{m|ru|прики́дка}} (akin to {{m|ru|кида́ть}}); {{m|ru|набро́сок}} (akin to {{m|ru|броса́ть}}).

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[plan]]ned [[endeavor]], usually with a specific [[goal]] and accomplished in several steps or stages.
#: {{syn|en|plan|Thesaurus:design}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=a. 1729|author={{w|John Rogers (priest)|John Rogers}}|title=The Greatness of the Gospel Salvation
|passage='''projects''' of happiness devised by human reason}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1924|author=w:Clarence Budington Kelland|title=s:The Steadfast Heart/Chapter 22
|passage=Rainbow, {{...}}came forward enthusiastically to put its money into the '''project''' in sums which ran all the way from one share at ten dollars to ten shares}}
#*: The proposal with China would involve a '''project''' to create artificial rain.
# {{lb|en|usually|in the plural|US}} An urban, low-income [[housing]] building.
#: {{syn|en|council estate|scheme}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Projects''' like Pruitt-Igoe were considered irreparably dangerous and demolished.}}
# {{lb|en|dated}} An idle [[scheme]]; an impracticable [[design]].
#: {{syn|en|Tower of Babel}}
#: {{ux|en|a man given to '''projects'''}}
# {{lb|en|US|sports}} A raw [[recruit]] who the team hopes will improve greatly with coaching; a [[long shot]], [[diamond in the rough]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=Oct 27 2014|author=Gabriele Marcotti|titleurl=https://www.espn.in/football/blog/name/62/post/2112824/headline|title=Ancelotti triumphs, van Gaal's progress, Dortmund disappoint, more|journal=ESPN FC
|passage=Sakho was seen as no-frills, whereas Maiga was a '''project''' who could develop into the next big thing.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200724110021/https://www.espn.in/football/blog/name/62/post/2112824/headline|archivedate=24 July 2020}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=Sep 2 2018|author=Arnie Melendrez Stapleton|titleurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200724105107/https://wnyt.com/sports/broncos-cut-ties-with-2016-first-round-pick-qb-lynch/5055527/|title=Broncos cut ties with 2016 first-round pick QB Lynch|journal=WNYT
|passage=Elway acknowledged at the time that Lynch was a '''project''' who needed some seasoning but he expressed hope that Lynch might be a quick study. He wasn't.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[projectile]].
#: {{syn|en|missile}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[projection]].
#: {{syn|en|protuberance|protrusion}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{senseid|en|extend beyond}} {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[extend]] beyond a surface.
#: {{synonyms|en|extend|jut|protrude|stick out}}
# {{senseid|en|cast an image}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[cast]] (an image or shadow) upon a surface; to throw or cast forward; to shoot forth.
#: {{syn|en|cast|throw|Thesaurus:throw}}
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|book=VI|canto=I|stanza=45|passage=Before his feet her selfe she did '''proiect'''}}
#* {{RQ:Pope Windsor Forest|passage=Behold! th' ascending villas on my side / '''Project''' long shadows o'er the crystal tide.}}
# {{senseid|en|extend something}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[extend]] (a protrusion or appendage) outward.
#: {{syn|en|extend|jut|jut out|exsert}}
# {{senseid|en|forecast}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To make plans for; to [[forecast]].
#: {{syn|en|forecast|foresee|foretell}}
#: {{ux|en|The CEO is '''projecting''' the completion of the acquisition by April 2007.}}
#* {{RQ:Landon Francesca Carrara|page=172|volume=III|text=To form a strict alliance between the cabinets of Paris and London—which meant, that he should influence both,—to induce Charles to marry the loveliest of his nieces, Hortense—thus making a common interest between them, were now the great objects with the Cardinal; and the present visit was of his '''projecting'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=2|passage='''projecting''' Peace and Warr?|year=1873}}
# {{senseid|en|present}} {{lb|en|transitive|reflexive}} To [[present]] (oneself), to [[convey]] a certain [[impression]], usually in a good way.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1946|author=Dr. Ralph S. Banay; The Milwaukee Journal|title=Is Modern Woman a Failure|url=http://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1499&dat=19461207&id=NS0aAAAAIBAJ&sjid=8iMEAAAAIBAJ&pg=4499,3742545
|passage=''It is difficult to gauge the exact point at which women stop trying to fool men and really begin to deceive themselves, but an objective analyst cannot escape the conclusion (1) that partly from a natural device inherent in the species, women deliberately '''project''' upon actual or potential suitors an impression of themselves that is not an accurate picture of their total nature, and (2) that few women ever are privileged to see themselves as they really are.''}}
# {{senseid|en|assume}} {{lb|en|transitive|psychology|psychoanalysis}} To [[assume]] [[quality|qualities]] or [[mindset]]s in others based on one's own [[personality]].
# {{senseid|en|spatial data}} {{lb|en|cartography}} To change the [[projection]] (or [[coordinate system]]) of [[spatial]] [[data]] with another projection.
# {{senseid|en|draw}} {{lb|en|geometry}} To [[draw]] straight lines from a fixed point through every point of any body or figure, and let these fall upon a surface so as to form the points of a new figure.
# {{senseid|en|neurons}} {{lb|en|neuroanatomy}} (of a neuron or group of neurons) to have [[axon]](s) extending to and therefore able to influence a remote location
# {{senseid|en|make something heard}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To cause (one's voice or words) to be heard at a great distance.
#: {{ux|en|to '''project''' one's voice}}
# {{senseid|en|make oneself heard}} {{lb|en|intransitive}} To speak or sing in such a way that one can be heard at a great distance.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2016|author=w:Sam Esmail; Courtney Looney|title=Mr. Robot: Red Wheelbarrow: eps1.91_redwheelbarr0w.txt|publisher={{w|Abrams Books}}, New York City|isbn=978-1-4197-2442-8
|passage=You would think that topic coulda put me to sleep, but HE can really '''project''' when HE wants to.}}
# {{senseid|en|reach}} {{lb|en|transitive|figurative}} To extend to reach a point.
